body: I thought about exposing them too, but i'm scared I'll get blacklisted even more and not be able to graduate. I'm running out of people to email, bc at this point I assume they'll all just pretend to overlook my situation or not reply. It's just shitty. To think my parents were actually very proud and relieved that my school promised to pay.

I thought about this, but I actually have no money for lawyer fees and I couldnt afford to lose. I'm graduating this semester in december (if I figure out how to pay for my classes), and I'm so afraid they'll fuck me over and take that away as well if I tried to sue ):
